description: Use when the user asks who the friends of a Steam player are or needs the friend list for a graph check. Source: the platform snapshot of the public Steam friend graph (cache only, no live Steam call; it can be partial - absence of a friendship is not proof). detail picks token cost: short - steamid64 array, medium - steamid64 + personaname, full - raw Steam objects; use short unless names are needed. Do not use for shared friends of two players (steam_compare).

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_friends

friends.description: entries shaped by detail: steamid64 strings, {steamid64, personaname} or {steamid64, steam}

title: Steam friend list
